test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct for using scribers?

options.text: Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents.
While scribing lines, the scriber is used like a pencil.
Scriber points are very sharp, so they are to be handled very carefully
Do not put the scriber in your pocket.

solution:
The correct answer is __Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents**(Option 1)**.__
